Disable hunger
If enabled, removes the hunger mechanic
Hide hunger bar
If enabled, hides the hunger bar from the HUD
Hunger effect

Vanilla: hunger effect has vanilla behaviour

Disabled: hunger effect is disabled, so it can never be applied to players

Replaced with other effect: instead of hunger effect, players get another effect (poison by default) with modified duration (two times shorter by default)
Hunger replacement effect
Sets up the identifier of the effect that replaces the hunger effect
Hunger replacement effect duration multiplier

Sets up the duration modification multiplier of the hunger replacement effect.

0.5 means two times shorter duration
Highlight potentially restorable hearts
If enabled, the HUD highlights the number of hearts that can be healed if player eats the currently held food item
Restorable hearts texture

Sets up the base texture that is used to draw potentially restorable hearts

Single color: the whole texture will be filled with one color set by the "Restorable hearts overlay color" option

Original: the regular heart texture will be used.
It usually looks weird when custom colors are overlaid

Blinking: the blinking variant of the heart texture will be used (in vanilla it's usually used when player gets damaged).
In standard resource pack it has a bright whitish-pink color, which is good for using with custom overlaid colors
Regenerating hearts texture

Sets up the base texture that is used to draw regenerating hearts

Single color: the whole texture will be filled with one color set by the "Regenerating hearts overlay color" option

Original: the regular heart texture will be used.
It usually looks weird when custom colors are overlaid

Blinking: the blinking variant of the heart texture will be used (in vanilla it's usually used when player gets damaged).
In standard resource pack it has a bright whitish-pink color, which is good for using with custom overlaid colors
Restorable hearts overlay color
Sets the color that is overlaid on top of the texture that is set by "Restorable hearts texture" for potentially restorable hearts
Enable gradual health regeneration
If enabled, makes health regenerate gradually over time after player eats the food
Gradual health regeneration speed
Sets the speed at which health is restored after player eats the food
Saturation based regeneration speed

If enabled, speed of gradual health regeneration will be calculated from the saturation level of consumed food items

If disabled, regeneration speed will be the same for all food items
Highlight regenerating hearts
If enabled, the HUD shows blinking animation for the number of hearts that are currently being regenerated by the food items that player has already eaten
Regenerating hearts overlay color
Sets the color that is overlaid on top of regular heart texture for currently regenerating hearts
Regenerating hearts opacity lower limit
Sets the lower limit of opacity for the blinking animation of currently regenerating hearts
Regenerating hearts opacity higher limit
Sets the higher limit of opacity for the blinking animation of currently regenerating hearts
Regenerating hearts blinking period
Sets the period length of the blinking animation of currently regenerating hearts in milliseconds
Regeneration at full health

Sets up how health regeneration system should behave after player has reached full health

Stopped: regeneration will stop once player's health is fully restored

Continued: regeneration will continue if player gets hurt during the regeneration period of consumed food items

Stored: regeneration of consumed food items will be stored indefinitely and will continue when player gets hurt
Disable eating animation
Disables the animation for eating food, making eating instantaneous
Show additional data on food item tooltips
If enabled, food item tooltips will show amount of health that can be healed and regeneration speed of that food item
Sprinting

Vanilla: sprinting has vanilla behaviour

Disabled: sprinting is always disabled

Limited by health: sprinting is only available if player's health is higher than the value set by option "Sprint health limit"
Sprint health limit
Sets the minimal amount of health that player must have to be able to sprint
Use custom food stack sizes
If enabled, custom food stack sizes shall be used
Set all food stack sizes to 1
Updates values for all food stack sizes to 1 (not stackable)
Set all food stack sizes to 64
Updates values for all food stack sizes to 64 (full stack)
Custom food stack sizes
Sets custom sizes for various food items
Farmer's Delight food stack sizes
Sets custom sizes for food items from Farmer's Delight mod
Hide experience bar
If enabled, hides experience bar from the HUD
Show experience bar on inventory screen
If enabled, makes experience bar appear on inventory screen
Show experience bar on workstation screens

If enabled, makes experience bar appear on certain workstation screens:
Enchanting table, anvil, grindstone, furnace, blast furnace and smoker
Show experience bar on gain
If enabled, makes experience bar appear at the moment after experience has been gained
Enable experience bar animation
If enabled, experience bar will have a smooth animation when it appears and disappears
Duration of the experience bar animation
Sets the duration of the experience bar animation in milliseconds
Render experience bar over background
Makes experience bar to be rendered on top of the screens' background, so it is more visible
Nourishment health boost hearts count

Sets the number of additional hearts that "Nourishment" effect from Farmer's Delight will give to players.

Set to 0 if you want to disable health boost completely
Nourishment health regeneration speed multiplier

Sets the speed bonus multiplier that "Nourishment" effect from Farmer's Delight will give to players.

2.0 means two times faster regeneration.

Set to 1.0 if you want to disable regeneration speed bonus
